However, Kotarou is forced to remain on the run when he finds himself being hunted down by assassins sent by China's Ming Dynasty for mysterious reasons not involving his petty crimes. Fortunately, the duo run into Nanashi, a ronin who has taken refuge in a small temple, when Kotarou is attacked and Tobimaru poisoned. Although the samurai saves the helpless pair from their pursuers, he feels that there is no need to help them further; but when offered a gem in exchange for his services as a bodyguard, he reluctantly accepts Kotarou's offer of employment—just until Tobimaru is healed and the two reach their destination. As the three set out on a perilous journey, it soon becomes evident that their path is riddled with danger, as the Ming Dynasty has now sent a terrifying swordsman after them to capture Kotarou and fulfill a certain prophecy. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En el período Sengoku de Japón, un joven huérfano llamado Kotarou y su perro Tobimaru roban a los aldeanos desprevenidos para poder llegar a fin de mes. Sin embargo, Kotarou se ve obligado a seguir huyendo cuando se ve perseguido por asesinos enviados por la dinastía Ming de China por razones misteriosas que no tienen que ver con sus delitos menores. 

Afortunadamente, el dúo se topa con Nanashi, un ronin que se ha refugiado en un pequeño templo, cuando Kotarou es atacado y Tobimaru envenenado. Aunque el samurái salva a la indefensa pareja de sus perseguidores, siente que no hay necesidad de ayudarlos más; pero cuando le ofrecen una gema a cambio de sus servicios como guardaespaldas, acepta de mala gana la oferta de empleo de Kotarou, justo hasta que Tobimaru se cura y los dos llegan a su destino. Mientras los tres emprenden un peligroso viaje, pronto se hace evidente que su camino está plagado de peligros, ya que la dinastía Ming ha enviado a un aterrador espadachín tras ellos para capturar a Kotarou y cumplir cierta profecía.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Vanitas no Karte Part 2
items.synopsis: Vanitas and Noé Archiviste head out to the town of Gévaudan in search of the "Beast," an enormous wolf-like creature that has slaughtered hundreds of people. Suspecting that the Beast is a curse-bearing vampire, Vanitas primarily aims to heal it using the powers of his grimoire. Along the way, the two get separated and suddenly travel back to the past—to the exact moment the Beast is lurking in the woods. After a battle against the gigantic wolf and a vampire hunter, Vanitas decides to team up with Jeanne in order to find Noé. Despite being allies, Jeanne's goal is the opposite of Vanitas', as she was tasked to kill the Beast—suspecting it may be someone she used to know. Meanwhile, a severely wounded Noé is picked up by the mysterious Chloé d'Apchier and her servant. Like Noé, Chloé is a vampire whose existence was erased from the public's knowledge. She has been a guardian for future generations and once tried to find a way to become human again. While Noé is grateful to Chloé for her hospitality, little does he know that she might be siding with forces far more dangerous than the Beast itself. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Vanitas y Noé Archiviste se dirigen a la ciudad de Gévaudan en busca de la "Bestia", una enorme criatura parecida a un lobo que ha masacrado a cientos de personas. Sospechando que la Bestia es un vampiro portador de una maldición, Vanitas apunta principalmente a curarla usando los poderes de su grimorio.

En el camino, los dos se separan y de repente viajan al pasado, al momento exacto en que la Bestia acecha en el bosque. Después de una batalla contra el lobo gigantesco y un cazador de vampiros, Vanitas decide formar equipo con Jeanne para encontrar a Noé. A pesar de ser aliados, el objetivo de Jeanne es el opuesto al de Vanitas, ya que se le asignó la tarea de matar a la Bestia, sospechando que podría ser alguien que solía conocer.

Mientras tanto, Noé, gravemente herido, es recogido por la misteriosa Chloé d'Apchier y su sirviente. Al igual que Noé, Chloé es una vampira cuya existencia fue borrada del conocimiento del público. Ha sido guardiana de las generaciones futuras y una vez intentó encontrar una manera de volver a ser humana. Si bien Noé está agradecido con Chloé por su hospitalidad, no sabe que ella podría estar del lado de fuerzas mucho más peligrosas que la propia Bestia.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama.
items.synopsis: After joining the resistance against the bakufu, Gintoki and the gang are in hiding, along with Katsura and his Joui rebels. The Yorozuya is soon approached by Nobume Imai and two members of the Kiheitai, who explain that the Harusame pirates have turned against 7th Division Captain Kamui and their former ally Takasugi. The Kiheitai present Gintoki with a job: find Takasugi, who has been missing since his ship was ambushed in a Harusame raid. Nobume also makes a stunning revelation regarding the Tendoushuu, a secret organization pulling the strings of numerous factions, and their leader Utsuro, the shadowy figure with an uncanny resemblance to Gintoki's former teacher. Hitching a ride on Sakamoto's space ship, the Yorozuya and Katsura set out for Rakuyou, Kagura's home planet, where the various factions have gathered and tensions are brewing. Long-held grudges, political infighting, and the Tendoushuu's sinister overarching plan finally culminate into a massive, decisive battle on Rakuyou. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Después de unirse a la resistencia contra el bakufu, Gintoki y la pandilla se esconden, junto con Katsura y sus rebeldes Joui. Pronto Nobume Imai y dos miembros del Kiheitai se acercan al Yorozuya, quienes explican que los piratas de Harusame se han vuelto contra el Capitán Kamui de la 7.ª División y su antiguo aliado Takasugi. Los Kiheitai le presentan un trabajo a Gintoki: encontrar a Takasugi, quien ha estado desaparecido desde que su barco fue emboscado en una incursión de Harusame. Nobume también hace una sorprendente revelación sobre Tendoushuu, una organización secreta que mueve los hilos de numerosas facciones, y su líder Utsuro, la figura sombría con un extraño parecido con el antiguo maestro de Gintoki.

Viajando en la nave espacial de Sakamoto, Yorozuya y Katsura partieron hacia Rakuyou, el planeta natal de Kagura, donde las distintas facciones se han reunido y se están gestando tensiones. Rencores de larga data, luchas políticas internas y el siniestro plan general del Tendoushuu finalmente culminan en una batalla masiva y decisiva en Rakuyou.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Conqueror of Shamballa
items.synopsis: In desperation, Edward Elric sacrificed his body and soul to rescue his brother Alphonse, and is now displaced in the heart of Munich, Germany. He struggles to adapt to a world completely foreign to him in the wake of the economic crisis that followed the end of World War I. Isolated and unable to return home with his alchemy skills, Edward continues to research other methods of escaping the prison alongside colleagues who bear striking resemblances to many of the people he left behind. As dissent brews among the German citizenry, its neighbors also feel the unrest of the humiliated nation. Meanwhile, Alphonse continues to investigate Edward's disappearance, delving into the science of alchemy in the hopes of finally reuniting with his older brother. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Mushishi Zoku Shou
items.synopsis: Perceived as strange and feared by man, over time the misshapen ones came to be known as Mushi. Although they harbor no ill intentions towards humans, many suffer from the side effects of their existence and strange nature; exploiting the Mushi without understanding them, even unintentionally, can lead to disaster and strife for any involved. Mushishi Zoku Shou continues the story of Mushishi Ginko on his journey to help the visible world to coexist with the Mushi. During his travels, Ginko discovers various gifted individuals—those cursed by circumstance and those maintaining a fragile symbiosis with the Mushi—inevitably confronting the question of whether humanity, talented and tortured alike, can manage the responsibility of the unseen. Moreover, as a Mushishi, Ginko must learn more about these strange beings and decide if he has the right to interfere with the complex relationships between Mushi and mankind. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Percibidos como extraños y temidos por el hombre, con el tiempo los deformes llegaron a ser conocidos como Mushi. Aunque no albergan malas intenciones hacia los humanos, muchos sufren los efectos secundarios de su existencia y su extraña naturaleza; explotar a los Mushi sin comprenderlos, incluso sin querer, puede provocar desastres y conflictos para cualquiera de los involucrados. Mushishi Zoku Shou continúa la historia de Mushishi Ginko en su viaje para ayudar al mundo visible a coexistir con los Mushi.

Durante sus viajes, Ginko descubre a varios individuos talentosos (aquellos maldecidos por las circunstancias y aquellos que mantienen una frágil simbiosis con los Mushi) que inevitablemente enfrentan la cuestión de si la humanidad, tanto talentosa como torturada, puede manejar la responsabilidad de lo invisible. Además, como Mushishi, Ginko debe aprender más sobre estos extraños seres y decidir si tiene derecho a interferir en las complejas relaciones entre Mushi y la humanidad.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite
items.synopsis: Twelve-year-old prodigy Rafal believes in living rationally, so as to earn praise and respect from society while not being led astray by his emotions. To this end, he publicly states his intention to study theology—the academic field held in highest regard in early 15th century Poland. However, an encounter with a mysterious man upends Rafal's life, sparking an illogical desire to instead pursue his passion for astronomy. Rafal is determined to prove the beauty and rationality of heliocentrism—the theory that the Earth revolves around the Sun. This belief is considered heretical by the powerful Church, which promotes geocentrism—the Sun revolving around the Earth—as the sole truth of the universe. Those whose beliefs do not align with the will of the Church suffer unfathomably gruesome consequences. In pursuit of evidence for a heliocentric model of the universe, Rafal grapples with obtaining precise calculations and building empirical theories. His greatest challenge, however, lies in conducting this research discreetly—lest he wish to meet the same fate as other heretics. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Rafal, un niño prodigio de doce años, cree en vivir racionalmente, para ganarse el elogio y el respeto de la sociedad sin dejarse llevar por sus emociones. Con este fin, declara públicamente su intención de estudiar teología, el campo académico más respetado en la Polonia de principios del siglo XV. Sin embargo, un encuentro con un hombre misterioso trastorna la vida de Rafal, provocando un deseo ilógico de dedicarse a su pasión por la astronomía.

Rafal está decidido a demostrar la belleza y la racionalidad del heliocentrismo: la teoría de que la Tierra gira alrededor del Sol. Esta creencia es considerada herética por la poderosa Iglesia, que promueve el geocentrismo (el Sol gira alrededor de la Tierra) como la única verdad del universo. Aquellos cuyas creencias no se alinean con la voluntad de la Iglesia sufren consecuencias insondablemente espantosas.

En busca de evidencia para un modelo heliocéntrico del universo, Rafal lucha por obtener cálculos precisos y construir teorías empíricas. Su mayor desafío, sin embargo, radica en realizar esta investigación discretamente, no sea que desee correr la misma suerte que otros herejes.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu
items.synopsis: Yotarou is a former yakuza member fresh out of prison and fixated on just one thing: rather than return to a life of crime, the young man aspires to take to the stage of rakugo, a traditional Japanese form of comedic storytelling. Inspired during his incarceration by the performance of distinguished practitioner Yakumo Yuurakutei, he sets his mind on meeting the man who changed his life. After hearing Yotarou's desperate appeal for his mentorship, Yakumo is left with no choice but to accept his very first apprentice. As he eagerly begins his training, Yotarou meets Konatsu, an abrasive young woman who has been under Yakumo's care ever since her beloved father Sukeroku Yuurakutei, another prolific rakugo performer, passed away. Through her hidden passion, Yotarou is drawn to Sukeroku's unique style of rakugo despite learning under contrasting techniques. Upon seeing this, old memories and feelings return to Yakumo who reminisces about a much earlier time when he made a promise with his greatest rival. Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu is a story set in both the past and present, depicting the art of rakugo, the relationships it creates, and the lives and hearts of those dedicated to keeping the unique form of storytelling alive. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Yotarou es un ex miembro de la yakuza recién salido de prisión y obsesionado con una sola cosa: en lugar de regresar a una vida criminal, el joven aspira a subir al escenario del rakugo, una forma tradicional japonesa de narración cómica. Inspirado durante su encarcelamiento por la actuación del distinguido practicante Yakumo Yuurakutei, se propone conocer al hombre que cambió su vida. Después de escuchar el desesperado llamamiento de Yotarou para que lo asesore, Yakumo no tiene más remedio que aceptar a su primer aprendiz.

Mientras comienza con entusiasmo su entrenamiento, Yotarou conoce a Konatsu, una joven abrasiva que ha estado bajo el cuidado de Yakumo desde que falleció su amado padre Sukeroku Yuurakutei, otro prolífico intérprete de rakugo. A través de su pasión oculta, Yotarou se siente atraída por el estilo único de rakugo de Sukeroku a pesar de aprender con técnicas contrastantes. Al ver esto, viejos recuerdos y sentimientos regresan a Yakumo, quien recuerda una época mucho anterior cuando hizo una promesa a su mayor rival.

Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu es una historia ambientada tanto en el pasado como en el presente, que representa el arte del rakugo, las relaciones que crea y las vidas y los corazones de aquellos dedicados a mantener viva esta forma única de contar historias.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Oda Nobuna no Yabou
items.synopsis: High school student Yoshiharu Sagara wakes up and finds himself in the middle of a raging Sengoku period battle. He is saved by the legendary Hideyoshi Toyotomi, but at the cost of the hero's life. With his dying breath, the warrior pleads for Yoshiharu to become a feudal lord in his place. Now that the course of history has been changed, Yoshiharu pledges to keep the timeline from diverging any further. Yet, after rescuing Nobuna Oda—whom he discovers is actually the fabled Nobunaga Oda's female counterpart—Yoshiharu realizes he has been transported to an alternate reality where most of Japan's historical warlords are now cute girls! To set things right and find a way back home, Yoshiharu agrees to become one of Nobuna's retainers and assist her in a conquest of Japan. As Nobuna initiates her campaign, Yoshiharu discovers that the history he learned from playing the video game "Nobunaga's Ambition" allows him to predict future events and turn the tide of war. Using this invaluable gift to aid the Oda clan's beautiful generals, Yoshiharu hopes to help his new lord fulfill her dream and win the hearts of women everywhere. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: InuYasha: Kanketsu-hen
items.synopsis: Thwarted again by Naraku, Inuyasha, Kagome Higurashi, and their friends must continue their hunt for the few remaining Shikon Jewel shards, lest they fully form into a corrupted jewel at the hands of Naraku. But Naraku has plans of his own to acquire them, and will destroy anyone and anything standing in his way—even his own underlings. The persistent, unyielding danger posed by Naraku forces Sango and Miroku to decide what is most important to them—each other or their duty in battle. Meanwhile, Inuyasha must decide whether his heart lies with Kikyou or Kagome, before fate decides for him. Amid the race to find the shards, Inuyasha and his brother Sesshoumaru must also resolve their feud and cooperate for their final confrontation with Naraku, as it is a battle they must win in order to put a stop to his evil and cruelty once and for all. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Frustrados nuevamente por Naraku, Inuyasha, Kagome Higurashi y sus amigos deben continuar su búsqueda de los pocos fragmentos restantes de la Joya Shikon, para que no se conviertan completamente en una joya corrupta a manos de Naraku. Pero Naraku tiene sus propios planes para adquirirlos y destruirá a cualquiera que se interponga en su camino, incluso a sus propios subordinados.

El peligro persistente e inquebrantable que representa Naraku obliga a Sango y Miroku a decidir qué es más importante para ellos: el uno al otro o su deber en la batalla. Mientras tanto, Inuyasha debe decidir si su corazón está con Kikyou o con Kagome, antes de que el destino decida por él. En medio de la carrera para encontrar los fragmentos, Inuyasha y su hermano Sesshoumaru también deben resolver su enemistad y cooperar para su enfrentamiento final con Naraku, ya que es una batalla que deben ganar para poner fin a su maldad y crueldad de una vez por todas.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Yuukoku no Moriarty Part 2
items.synopsis: Great Britain is ablaze with news of a so-called "Lord of Crime," a criminal mastermind responsible for the downfall of several unruly nobles. In truth, the Lord of Crime is not an individual, but rather a group consisting of William James Moriarty and his two brothers, Louis and Albert. Together, they wish to destroy everything rotten about their current world and create a new, fair society for all. To accomplish their goal, they must commit criminal acts, which the great detective Sherlock Holmes and his partner, John H. Watson, cannot abide by. A dangerous cat and mouse game begins between the Lord of Crime and Sherlock, with each trying to outwit the other. Yet Sherlock, despite his skills, has no idea that his foe is right under his nose. Involved with both parties is a woman named Irene Adler, who is as beautiful as she is cunning. No stranger to scandal, Irene has embroiled herself in one that may be too big even for her, as the classified documents she stole could shake the very foundations of the British Empire. Can Irene be saved, or does a deadly future await her? [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Gran Bretaña arde con noticias sobre el llamado "Señor del Crimen", un cerebro criminal responsable de la caída de varios nobles rebeldes. En verdad, el Señor del Crimen no es un individuo, sino un grupo formado por William James Moriarty y sus dos hermanos, Louis y Albert. Juntos, desean destruir todo lo podrido de su mundo actual y crear una sociedad nueva y justa para todos. Para lograr su objetivo, deben cometer actos criminales que el gran detective Sherlock Holmes y su socio, John H. Watson, no pueden tolerar. Comienza un peligroso juego del gato y el ratón entre el Señor del Crimen y Sherlock, en el que cada uno intenta burlar al otro. Sin embargo, Sherlock, a pesar de sus habilidades, no tiene idea de que su enemigo está justo delante de sus narices.

En ambas partes participa una mujer llamada Irene Adler, que es tan hermosa como astuta. Irene, que no es ajena a los escándalos, se ha visto envuelta en uno que puede ser demasiado grande incluso para ella, ya que los documentos clasificados que robó podrían sacudir los cimientos mismos del Imperio Británico. ¿Podrá Irene salvarse o le espera un futuro mortal?

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Mushishi Zoku Shou 2nd Season
items.synopsis: Ghostly, primordial beings known as Mushi continue to cause mysterious changes in the lives of humans. The travelling Mushishi, Ginko, persists in trying to set right the strange and unsettling situations he encounters. Time loops, living shadows, and telepathy are among the overt effects of interference from Mushi, but more subtle symptoms that take years to be noticed also rouse Ginko's concern as he passes from village to village. Through circumstance, Ginko has become an arbiter, determining which Mushi are blessings and which are curses. But the lines that he seeks to draw are subjective. Some of his patients would rather exercise their new powers until they are utterly consumed by them; others desperately strive to rid themselves of afflictions which are in fact protecting their lives from devastation. Those who cross paths with Mushi must learn to accept seemingly impossible consequences for their actions, and heal wounds they did not know they had. Otherwise, they risk meeting with fates beyond their comprehension. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Seres primordiales fantasmales conocidos como Mushi continúan provocando cambios misteriosos en la vida de los humanos. El viajero Mushishi, Ginko, persiste en intentar corregir las situaciones extrañas e inquietantes que encuentra. Los bucles temporales, las sombras vivientes y la telepatía se encuentran entre los efectos abiertos de la interferencia de Mushi, pero síntomas más sutiles que tardan años en notarse también despiertan la preocupación de Ginko mientras pasa de aldea en aldea.

Debido a las circunstancias, Ginko se ha convertido en un árbitro que determina qué Mushi son bendiciones y cuáles son maldiciones. Pero las líneas que intenta trazar son subjetivas. Algunos de sus pacientes preferirían ejercer sus nuevos poderes hasta que los consumieran por completo; otros luchan desesperadamente por librarse de aflicciones que en realidad protegen sus vidas de la devastación. Aquellos que se cruzan con Mushi deben aprender a aceptar consecuencias aparentemente imposibles de sus acciones y curar heridas que no sabían que tenían. De lo contrario, corren el riesgo de encontrarse con destinos que escapan a su comprensión.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kurenai no Buta
items.synopsis: After a curse turned him into a pig, World War I ace Marco Pagot becomes Porco Rosso, a mysterious bounty hunter who takes down sky pirates in the Adriatic Sea. He whiles away his days on a secluded island, rarely leaving other than to collect bounties or to visit the beautiful Gina, a songstress and owner of the Hotel Adriano. One day, while traveling to fix his faulty engine, Porco Rosso is gunned down by a young American hotshot named Donald Curtis. Thrilled at the possibility of fame, Donald boldly declares that the flying pig is dead. Not wanting to disappoint Gina, Porco Rosso flees to the famous Piccolo S.P.A. airplane company and takes out a massive loan in order to repair and improve his fighter plane. There, he is surprised to find that the chief engineer of Piccolo S.P.A. is the 17-year-old Fio Piccolo, who hungers for a chance to prove herself. With Fio's improvements, Porco Rosso prepares to challenge Donald officially and regain his honor. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Tsuioku-hen
items.synopsis: When mankind's savagery surpasses his fear of death, there is little hope for those who wish to live honest lives. Beneath a full moon, a young boy witnesses the murder of the bandits who had enslaved him, and is then christened with a new name by the man who rescued him. This boy is Shinta, now known as Kenshin Himura, and he is destined to become a swordsman. The softness of his heart does not befit the occupation, but his desire to protect the innocent is absolute. Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Tsuioku-hen details the origins of the man who would bear the name of Hitokiri Battousai long before he swore his oath not to kill and before he earned his reputation as an assassin. The young man's heart is divided between justice and corruption, while the fate of a nation rests on his actions. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Cuando el salvajismo de la humanidad supera su miedo a la muerte, hay pocas esperanzas para quienes desean vivir una vida honesta. Bajo la luna llena, un niño presencia el asesinato de los bandidos que lo habían esclavizado y luego el hombre que lo rescató lo bautiza con un nuevo nombre. Este chico es Shinta, ahora conocido como Kenshin Himura, y está destinado a convertirse en espadachín. La dulzura de su corazón no corresponde a la ocupación, pero su deseo de proteger a los inocentes es absoluto.

Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Tsuioku-hen detalla los orígenes del hombre que llevaría el nombre de Hitokiri Battousai mucho antes de que hiciera su juramento de no matar y antes de que se ganara su reputación como asesino. El corazón del joven está dividido entre la justicia y la corrupción, mientras que el destino de una nación depende de sus acciones.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kuroshitsuji: Book of Murder
items.synopsis: At the behest of the Queen, Earl Ciel Phantomhive hosts a lavish dinner party attended by several of the finest members of polite society—as well as struggling author, Arthur. But as the party reaches its high, a terrible murder takes place and none other than the Earl himself is suspected of the crime. As a violent storm rages on outside, the death count continues to climb. The Phantomhive household and their eminent guests find they must cooperate in order to solve this mystery before they too fall prey to the mysterious murderer. However, it seems that not even the perfect butler, Sebastian Michaelis, is safe from this horror. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
A instancias de la Reina, el Conde Ciel Phantomhive organiza una lujosa cena a la que asisten varios de los mejores miembros de la sociedad educada, así como el escritor en apuros Arthur. Pero cuando la fiesta llega a su punto máximo, se produce un terrible asesinato y nada menos que el propio Conde es sospechoso del crimen.

Mientras afuera azota una violenta tormenta, el número de muertos continúa aumentando. La familia Phantomhive y sus eminentes invitados descubren que deben cooperar para resolver este misterio antes de que ellos también sean víctimas del misterioso asesino. Sin embargo, parece que ni siquiera el perfecto mayordomo, Sebastian Michaelis, está a salvo de este horror.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Sirius
items.synopsis: In the year 1930, vampires have infiltrated Tokyo to feast upon its unsuspecting citizens. As the number of victims continues to rise, the city's authorities decide to hire the Jaegers—a strange, diverse group of individuals tasked by the V Shipping Company to hunt down vampires around the world. Carrying musical instrument cases to disguise their identity, the Jaegers battle the vampires with the same mercilessness demonstrated by their foes. Yuliy, the Jaeger's most skilled warrior, is the sole survivor of a vampire raid on his home village. Using the strength granted by his werewolf blood, he works with his team to assist Tokyo's law enforcement with the city's vampire problem. Though under the pretense of helping the police, the Jaegers are actually fighting the vampires over the mystical Ark of Sirius. With its power to change the fate of the world, Yuliy and his friends must locate the artifact before the vampires can use it to achieve their destructive goals. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Hetalia Axis Powers
items.synopsis: In a tumultuous era of World Wars and general uncertainty for the future, Germany did not expect that his only constant allies would be North Italy and Japan. Despite being a descendant of the once-powerful Ancient Rome, North Italy is weak, useless, and overly in love with pasta. In contrast, Japan is reliable and pragmatic, but has strange obsessions that would bewilder anyone. Believing he drew the short end of the straw, Germany must think of a way to make this unlikely alliance work. To rub salt into the wound, the chaotic Allied Forces arrive, determined to stop the Axis Powers in their tracks. While they all share a common goal, none of the Allies can set aside their centuries of differences to fight as a cohesive front. As conflicts continue, these personified nations act out the events of World Wars I and II in a comedic and entertaining manner. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En una era tumultuosa de guerras mundiales y de incertidumbre general sobre el futuro, Alemania no esperaba que sus únicos aliados constantes fueran el norte de Italia y Japón. A pesar de ser descendiente de la otrora poderosa Antigua Roma, el norte de Italia es débil, inútil y demasiado enamorado de la pasta. Por el contrario, Japón es confiable y pragmático, pero tiene extrañas obsesiones que desconcertarían a cualquiera. Al creer que ha sacado la peor parte, Alemania debe pensar en una manera de hacer que esta improbable alianza funcione.

Para echar sal en la herida, llegan las caóticas Fuerzas Aliadas, decididas a detener a las potencias del Eje en seco. Si bien todos comparten un objetivo común, ninguno de los aliados puede dejar de lado sus siglos de diferencias para luchar como un frente cohesivo. A medida que continúan los conflictos, estas naciones personificadas representan los acontecimientos de la Primera y Segunda Guerra Mundial de una manera cómica y entretenida.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kingdom
items.synopsis: China’s Warring States period, a raging dragon that would raze the land for 500 years, saw many kingdoms rise and fall, making way for the next generation of kings and generals to fight for supremacy. Eventually, seven powerful states emerged from the endless cycle of warfare. In the kingdom of Qin, Xin, a war-orphaned slave, trains vigorously with fellow slave and best friend, Piao, who shares his proud dream of one day becoming a Great General of the Heavens. However, the two are suddenly forced to part ways when Piao is recruited to work in the royal palace by a retainer of the King. After a fierce coup d'état unfolds, Piao returns to Xin, half dead, with a mission that will lead him to a meeting with China's young King, Ying Zheng, who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Kingdom follows Xin as he takes his first steps into the great blood-soaked pages of China's history. He must carve his own path to glory on his long quest to become a Great General of the historic Seven Warring States. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kaguya-hime no Monogatari
items.synopsis: Deep in the countryside, a man named Okina works as a bamboo cutter in a forest, chopping away at the hollow plants day after day. One day, he discovers a small baby inside a glowing shoot. He immediately takes her home, convinced that she is a princess sent to Earth as a divine blessing from heaven. Okina and his wife Ouna take it upon themselves to raise the infant as their own, watching over her as she quickly grows into an energetic young girl. Given the name Kaguya, she fits right in with the village she has come to call home, going on adventures with the other children and enjoying what youth has to offer. But when Okina finds a large fortune of gold and treasure in the forest, Kaguya's life is completely changed. Believing this to be yet another gift from heaven, he takes it upon himself to turn his daughter into a real princess using the wealth he has just obtained, relocating the family to a mansion in the capital. As she leaves her friends behind to enter into an unwanted life of royalty, Kaguya's origins and purpose slowly come to light. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En lo profundo del campo, un hombre llamado Okina trabaja como cortador de bambú en un bosque, cortando las plantas huecas día tras día. Un día, descubre un pequeño bebé dentro de un brote brillante. Inmediatamente la lleva a casa, convencido de que es una princesa enviada a la Tierra como una bendición divina del cielo. Okina y su esposa Ouna se encargan de criar a la bebé como si fuera suya, cuidándola mientras rápidamente se convierte en una joven enérgica. Dado el nombre de Kaguya, encaja perfectamente con el pueblo al que ha llegado a llamar hogar, viviendo aventuras con los otros niños y disfrutando de lo que la juventud tiene para ofrecer.

Pero cuando Okina encuentra una gran fortuna de oro y un tesoro en el bosque, la vida de Kaguya cambia por completo. Creyendo que se trata de un regalo más del cielo, se encarga de convertir a su hija en una auténtica princesa utilizando la riqueza que acaba de obtener, trasladando a la familia a una mansión en la capital. Mientras deja atrás a sus amigos para entrar en una vida de realeza no deseada, los orígenes y el propósito de Kaguya poco a poco salen a la luz.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama Movie 2: Kanketsu-hen - Yorozuya yo Eien Nare
items.synopsis: When Gintoki Sakata apprehends a movie pirate at a premiere, he checks the camera's footage and finds himself transported to a bleak, post-apocalyptic version of Edo, where a mysterious epidemic called the "White Plague" has ravished the world's population. It turns out that the movie pirate was not a pirate after all—it was an android time machine, and Gintoki has been hurtled five years into the future! Shinpachi Shimura and Kagura, his Yorozuya cohorts, have had a falling out and are now battle-hardened solo vigilantes and he himself has been missing for years, disappearing without a trace after scribbling a strange message in his journal. Setting out in the disguise given to him by the android time machine, Gintoki haphazardly reunites the Yorozuya team to investigate the White Plague, and soon discovers that the key to saving the future lies in the darkness of his own past. Determined to confront a powerful foe, he makes an important discovery—with a ragtag band of friends and allies at his side, he does not have to fight alone. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Cuando Gintoki Sakata detiene a un pirata cinematográfico en un estreno, revisa las imágenes de la cámara y se ve transportado a una versión sombría y post-apocalíptica de Edo, donde una misteriosa epidemia llamada "Peste Blanca" ha asolado a la población mundial. Resulta que, después de todo, el pirata de la película no era un pirata: era una máquina del tiempo de Android, ¡y Gintoki ha sido lanzado cinco años hacia el futuro! Shinpachi Shimura y Kagura, sus compañeros de Yorozuya, han tenido una pelea y ahora son vigilantes solitarios curtidos en la batalla y él mismo ha estado desaparecido durante años, desapareciendo sin dejar rastro después de garabatear un extraño mensaje en su diario.

Con el disfraz que le dio la máquina del tiempo android, Gintoki reúne al azar al equipo de Yorozuya para investigar la Peste Blanca y pronto descubre que la clave para salvar el futuro reside en la oscuridad de su propio pasado. Decidido a enfrentarse a un enemigo poderoso, hace un descubrimiento importante: con un grupo heterogéneo de amigos y aliados a su lado, no tiene que luchar solo.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Mo Dao Zu Shi
items.synopsis: Xian: the state of immortality that all cultivators strive to achieve. However, there is a dark energy that lies underneath—the forbidden Mo Dao, or demonic path. Through an unfortunate series of tragedies, this is the path that cultivator Wei Wuxian experiments with during his teachings. His rise in power is accompanied by chaos and destruction, but his reign of terror comes to an abrupt end when the cultivation clans overpower him and he is killed by his closest ally. Thirteen years later, Wei Wuxian is reincarnated in the body of a lunatic and reunited with Lan Wangji, a former classmate of his. This marks the beginning of a supernatural mystery that plagues the clans and threatens to disrupt their everyday life. Mo Dao Zu Shi follows these two men on their mission to unravel the mysteries of the spiritual world. Fighting demons, ghosts, and even other cultivators, the two end up forming a bond that neither of them had ever expected. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Xian: el estado de inmortalidad que todos los cultivadores se esfuerzan por alcanzar. Sin embargo, hay una energía oscura que yace debajo: el Mo Dao prohibido, o camino demoníaco. A través de una desafortunada serie de tragedias, este es el camino que el cultivador Wei Wuxian experimenta durante sus enseñanzas. Su ascenso en el poder va acompañado de caos y destrucción, pero su reinado de terror llega a un final abrupto cuando los clanes de cultivo lo dominan y es asesinado por su aliado más cercano.

Trece años después, Wei Wuxian se reencarna en el cuerpo de un lunático y se reúne con Lan Wangji, un antiguo compañero de clase suyo. Esto marca el comienzo de un misterio sobrenatural que asola a los clanes y amenaza con alterar su vida cotidiana.

Mo Dao Zu Shi sigue a estos dos hombres en su misión de desentrañar los misterios del mundo espiritual. Luchando contra demonios, fantasmas e incluso contra otros cultivadores, los dos terminan formando un vínculo que ninguno de los dos esperaba.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken
items.synopsis: In the American Old West, the world's greatest race is about to begin. Thousands line up in San Diego to travel over six thousand kilometers for a chance to win the grand prize of fifty million dollars. With the era of the horse reaching its end, contestants are allowed to use any kind of vehicle they wish. Competitors will have to endure grueling conditions, traveling up to a hundred kilometers a day through uncharted wastelands. The Steel Ball Run is truly a one-of-a-kind event. The youthful Johnny Joestar, a crippled former horse racer, has come to San Diego to watch the start of the race. There he encounters Gyro Zeppeli, a racer with two steel balls at his waist instead of a gun. Johnny witnesses Gyro using one of his steel balls to unleash a fantastical power, compelling a man to fire his gun at himself during a duel. In the midst of the action, Johnny happens to touch the steel ball and feels a power surging through his legs, allowing him to stand up for the first time in two years. Vowing to find the secret of the steel balls, Johnny decides to compete in the race, and so begins his bizarre adventure across America on the Steel Ball Run. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En el Viejo Oeste americano, la carrera más grande del mundo está a punto de comenzar. Miles de personas hacen fila en San Diego para viajar más de seis mil kilómetros y tener la oportunidad de ganar el gran premio de cincuenta millones de dólares. Con la era del caballo llegando a su fin, los concursantes pueden utilizar cualquier tipo de vehículo que deseen. Los competidores tendrán que soportar condiciones agotadoras, viajando hasta cien kilómetros por día a través de páramos inexplorados. Steel Ball Run es verdaderamente un evento único en su tipo.

El joven Johnny Joestar, un ex corredor de caballos lisiado, ha venido a San Diego para presenciar el inicio de la carrera. Allí se encuentra con Gyro Zeppeli, un corredor con dos bolas de acero en la cintura en lugar de una pistola. Johnny es testigo de cómo Gyro usa una de sus bolas de acero para desatar un poder fantástico, lo que obliga a un hombre a dispararse a sí mismo durante un duelo. En medio de la acción, Johnny toca la bola de acero y siente un poder surgiendo a través de sus piernas, lo que le permite ponerse de pie por primera vez en dos años. Prometiendo encontrar el secreto de las bolas de acero, Johnny decide competir en la carrera y así comienza su extraña aventura por todo Estados Unidos en Steel Ball Run.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Golden Kamuy 2nd Season
items.synopsis: In Hokkaido, it is rumored that there is a stash of hidden gold. This gold was supposedly stolen by a man who killed the original Ainu owners; and before being captured and imprisoned by the police, he hid it in a secret location. In order to relay the gold's location to his comrades on the outside, he tattooed the map on the bodies of his cellmates and promised them a share of the gold—provided they managed to escape and find it. First Lieutenant Tokushirou Tsurumi plans to give the 7th Division an advantage in the war for the tattoos by getting a taxidermist to create skins that only he can distinguish as fake. Meanwhile, Saichi Sugimoto, Asirpa, and their companions continue their hunt for the skins by following a strange rumor: a thief who broke into a home in Yubari found taxidermied human corpses, among which was a torso with strange tattoos. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En Hokkaido se rumorea que hay un alijo de oro escondido. Este oro supuestamente fue robado por un hombre que mató a los propietarios originales Ainu; y antes de ser capturado y encarcelado por la policía, lo escondió en un lugar secreto. Para transmitir la ubicación del oro a sus camaradas en el exterior, tatuó el mapa en los cuerpos de sus compañeros de celda y les prometió una parte del oro, siempre que lograran escapar y encontrarlo.

El primer teniente Tokushirou Tsurumi planea darle a la 7.ª División una ventaja en la guerra por los tatuajes al conseguir que un taxidermista cree pieles que solo él pueda distinguir como falsas. Mientras tanto, Saichi Sugimoto, Asirpa y sus compañeros continúan su búsqueda de las pieles siguiendo un extraño rumor: un ladrón que irrumpió en una casa en Yubari encontró cadáveres humanos disecados, entre los que se encontraba un torso con extraños tatuajes.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama. Shirogane no Tamashii-hen
items.synopsis: After the fierce battle on Rakuyou, the untold past and true goal of the immortal Naraku leader, Utsuro, are finally revealed. By corrupting the Altana reserves of several planets, Utsuro has successfully triggered the intervention of the Tendoshuu’s greatest enemy: the Altana Liberation Army. With Earth as the main battleground in this interplanetary war, Utsuro's master plan to destroy the planet—and himself—is nearly complete. An attack on the O-Edo Central Terminal marks the beginning of the final battle to take back the land of the samurai. With the Yorozuya nowhere in sight, the bakufu all but collapsed, and the Shogun missing, the people are left completely helpless as the Liberation Army begins pillaging Edo in the name of freeing them from the Tendoshuu's rule. Caught in the crossfire between two equally imposing forces, can Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi, and the former students of Shouyou Yoshida put aside their differences and unite their allies to protect what they hold dear? [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Después de la feroz batalla en Rakuyou, finalmente se revela el pasado no contado y el verdadero objetivo del inmortal líder Naraku, Utsuro. Al corromper las reservas de Altana de varios planetas, Utsuro ha provocado con éxito la intervención del mayor enemigo del Tendoshuu: el Ejército de Liberación de Altana. Con la Tierra como principal campo de batalla en esta guerra interplanetaria, el plan maestro de Utsuro para destruir el planeta (y a él mismo) está casi completo. 

Un ataque a la terminal central de O-Edo marca el comienzo de la batalla final para recuperar la tierra de los samuráis. Sin el Yorozuya a la vista, el bakufu casi colapsado y el Shogun desaparecido, la gente queda completamente indefensa cuando el Ejército de Liberación comienza a saquear Edo en nombre de liberarlos del dominio del Tendoshuu. 

Atrapados en el fuego cruzado entre dos fuerzas igualmente imponentes, ¿podrán Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi y los antiguos alumnos de Shouyou Yoshida dejar de lado sus diferencias y unir a sus aliados para proteger lo que más aprecian?

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Chrno Crusade
items.synopsis: The 1920s was a decade of great change and upheaval, with monstrous demons appearing across America. To combat this menace, the holy organization known as the Order of Magdalene was established. The organization's New York branch is home to the young and reckless Sister Rosette Christopher, as well as her partner Chrno. Tasked with the extermination of demonic threats, the renowned team is excellent at their job, despite causing extensive collateral damage on their missions. However, both Rosette and Chrno are driven by their dark pasts. Through exterminating demons, Rosette hopes to find her lost brother Joshua who was taken by the sinner and demon, Aion, with whom Chrno also shares a bloody history. The two of them must fight off the increasingly dangerous demonic menace and discover its source, while continuing to search for the truth behind Joshua's disappearance. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Aoi Bungaku Series
items.synopsis: 1. Ningen Shikkaku 2. Sakura no Mori no Mankai no Shita 3. Kokoro 4. Hashire, Melos! 5. Kumo no Ito 6. Jigokuhen

items.title: Coquelicot-zaka kara
items.synopsis: Atop a hill overlooking a seaside port sits a boarding house named Coquelicot Manor. Since the building is run by her family, Umi Matsuzaki carries out many of the duties involved in managing the small establishment, such as preparing meals for her fellow boarders. When she isn't at home, she is a student at the local high school—one that is currently dealing with a small crisis. In anticipation of the upcoming Olympic Games, a beloved old clubhouse is set to be demolished to make way for a modern building. As a result, a large part of the student body has banded together, working tirelessly to prevent this from happening. Umi finds herself helping the newspaper club to spread information about this cause where she befriends Shun Kazama, whom she gradually begins to fall in love with. But Shun is an orphan who doesn't know much about his origins, and when the two begin searching for clues to the boy's past, they discover that they may have a lot more in common than either of them could have thought. [Writtten by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kaizoku Oujo
items.synopsis: A decade ago, a tragic shipwreck separated Fena Houtman from her childhood friend Yukimaru and took her father's life. Now, at age 23, she is trapped on an island and is doomed to spend the rest of her life selling herself to men. On the night she is to be forcibly wed to a client, Fena hatches a plan to escape from her employers, but two old acquaintances unexpectedly intervene and help her run away. The three make haste for the open sea and land upon Goblin Island—a mysterious place that a clan of fierce warriors call home. It is there that Fena learns that her father's ill-fated final journey at sea was in search of a place called "Eden," the location of something important that he had to protect. With nothing but a clear crystal as a clue, Fena is tasked with finding this place, as she is the only person who can do so. While still contemplating the search for what her father left behind, Fena reunites with Yukimaru, who encourages her to take up the quest. Now the captain of a seven-person crew, Fena must navigate the high seas in search of Eden. But as uncanny groups begin to target her, the perilous journey proves to be even more challenging than it previously seemed. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama. Shirogane no Tamashii-hen - Kouhan-sen
items.synopsis: Following the temporary retreat of the Altana Liberation Army from the Kabuki District, the state of the war has seemingly improved. However, as the Oniwaban, Shinsengumi, and residents of the district combat the army's remnants, Edo's greatest inventor Gengai Hiraga is abducted. Responsible for causing the enemy's withdrawal by rendering their weapons useless, Gengai's nanomachine virus is now at risk of being shut down. Meanwhile, a laser capable of obliterating a planet is activated in Earth's orbit on the Liberation Army's mother ship. Another battle ensues when Shinsuke Takasugi and the rest of the Kiheitai arrive on the vessel to stop the weapon from firing. Forced to fight a war on two fronts, the Yorozuya and their allies must prevail on both sides to save Edo and the rest of the world. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Tras la retirada temporal del Ejército de Liberación de Altana del distrito de Kabuki, el estado de la guerra aparentemente ha mejorado. Sin embargo, mientras los Oniwaban, Shinsengumi y los residentes del distrito luchan contra los restos del ejército, el mayor inventor de Edo, Gengai Hiraga, es secuestrado. Responsable de provocar la retirada del enemigo al inutilizar sus armas, el virus nanomáquina de Gengai corre ahora el riesgo de ser desactivado.

Mientras tanto, un láser capaz de destruir un planeta se activa en la órbita de la Tierra en la nave nodriza del Ejército de Liberación. Se produce otra batalla cuando Shinsuke Takasugi y el resto de Kiheitai llegan al barco para detener el disparo del arma. Obligados a librar una guerra en dos frentes, los Yorozuya y sus aliados deben prevalecer en ambos lados para salvar a Edo y al resto del mundo.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kuroshitsuji Movie: Book of the Atlantic
items.synopsis: The young Earl Ciel Phantomhive—the Queen's Guard Dog—is once again called to investigate seemingly supernatural phenomena when news of miraculous resurrections begins to surface in Victorian London. Along with Sebastian Michaelis, his demon butler, they board the luxury cruise liner Campania to investigate rumors of the Aurora Society—a medical organization suspected of experimenting on the dead. Grim reapers begin to appear on the ship, and it becomes apparent that the ship is about to be overrun with the undead as a devious plan is put into motion. Ciel and Sebastian must now uncover the secrets that lie behind the Aurora Society's phoenix symbol, and with the help of some old acquaintances, return the undead to their coffins or share a watery grave. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
El joven Earl Ciel Phantomhive, el perro guardián de la reina, es llamado una vez más a investigar fenómenos aparentemente sobrenaturales cuando comienzan a surgir noticias de resurrecciones milagrosas en el Londres victoriano. Junto con Sebastian Michaelis, su demonio mayordomo, abordan el crucero de lujo Campania para investigar los rumores sobre la Sociedad Aurora, una organización médica sospechosa de experimentar con los muertos.

Las Parcas comienzan a aparecer en el barco, y se hace evidente que el barco está a punto de ser invadido por los no-muertos mientras se pone en marcha un plan tortuoso. Ciel y Sebastian ahora deben descubrir los secretos que se esconden detrás del símbolo del fénix de la Sociedad Aurora y, con la ayuda de algunos viejos conocidos, devolver a los no-muertos a sus ataúdes o compartir una tumba de agua.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season
items.synopsis: In the aftermath of the Shi Clan's rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi. (Source: Crunchyroll)
items.synopsis_es:
A raíz de la rebelión del Clan Shi, las cosas finalmente se calmaron y Maomao ha regresado a su antigua vida como farmacéutica en el distrito del placer. Un día, provocado por un desayuno servido en Verdigris House, Maomao siente una anomalía y comienza a investigar su verdadera naturaleza. Mientras tanto, Jinshi, que ha revelado su verdadera identidad como hermano imperial y ha comenzado a afrontar sus pesadas responsabilidades, está profundamente preocupado por el mensaje final dejado por Loulan: una advertencia de un inminente "desastre que golpeará a la nación". Para empeorar las cosas, los rumores sobre una misteriosa doncella del santuario que engaña a la gente comienzan a extenderse, proyectando una sombra oscura sobre el país de Li una vez más. Desde las profundidades del patio interior hasta las calles de la ciudad y más allá de las fronteras extranjeras, el mundo se hace más amplio y lo que está en juego es aún mayor para Maomao y Jinshi.

(Fuente: Crunchyroll)

items.title: Princess Principal
items.synopsis: In the early 20th century, the discovery of the substance Cavorite allowed the production of advanced military technology and steered the country toward conflict. London is now divided by a wall, and the Kingdom and the Commonwealth of Albion battle a silent war where espionage is the only weapon that can destabilize the enemy. A group of girls from the prestigious Queen's Mayfaire school work as undercover spies for the Commonwealth. Led by Dorothy, an experienced driver with a striking personality, their group includes the talents of Ange le Carré, a cold-blooded liar and expert sharpshooter; Chise, a proficient samurai; and Beatrice, a voice-mimicking specialist. They use their unique individual skills for the Commonwealth to survive in a dark world filled with conspiracy, mystery, and infiltration. In the shadow of the war, they have only one goal in mind: completing their mission. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama. Porori-hen
items.synopsis: Following the grim events of Iga, Kokujou Island, Rakuyou, and multiple fruitless confrontations with the Tenshouin Naraku and Tendoshuu, Gintama. Porori-hen takes its viewers on a trip down memory lane to when Yorozuya were mostly doing what they did best—odd jobs. The great space hunter Umibouzu has returned to Edo and is livid when he finds out that his daughter Kagura has a boyfriend. He blames Gintoki for being an incompetent guardian, but has the time finally come for him to let go of his daughter? Back with shameless parodies, risqué humor, and lively camaraderie, Gintoki, Kagura, and Shinpachi are faced with unforeseen situations that manage to be both hilarious and emotionally stirring. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Tras los sombríos acontecimientos de Iga, la isla Kokujou, Rakuyou y múltiples enfrentamientos infructuosos con Tenshouin Naraku y Tendoshuu, Gintama. Porori-hen lleva a sus espectadores a un viaje al pasado, a cuando Yorozuya hacía principalmente lo que mejor hacía: trabajos ocasionales. El gran cazador espacial Umibouzu ha regresado a Edo y se pone furioso cuando descubre que su hija Kagura tiene novio. Culpa a Gintoki por ser un guardián incompetente, pero ¿finalmente ha llegado el momento de dejar ir a su hija?

De vuelta con parodias descaradas, humor atrevido y camaradería animada, Gintoki, Kagura y Shinpachi se enfrentan a situaciones imprevistas que logran ser a la vez divertidas y conmovedoras.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi
items.synopsis: Tokiyuki Houjou, a carefree eight-year-old noble, is content with the serene life in Kamakura and shows little regard for the serious responsibilities that come with his eventually succeeding his father as the next shogun. Instead of dedicating himself to rigorous training in swordsmanship or archery, Tokiyuki excels in the art of evasion, skillfully dodging his advisors and discovering perfect hiding spots. However, his peaceful existence is shattered when a sudden coup brutally wipes out his clan. Overwhelmed with guilt for being the sole survivor, Tokiyuki contemplates joining his family in death. However, his fate takes an abrupt turn when the enigmatic priest Yorishige Suwa suddenly shoves him onto a battlefield. Yorishige, who prophesies that Tokiyuki will one day become a great hero, leaves the boy with no choice but to navigate his way free of enemy soldiers. As Tokiyuki struggles to survive against these foes, he finds a new thrill in raising the stakes of his usual hide-and-seek games. With a renewed sense of purpose and the promise of powerful allies from Yorishige, Tokiyuki vows to avenge his family—not through his capability to fight, but through his extraordinary talent for running away. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Joker Game
items.synopsis: With World War II right around the corner, intelligence on other countries' social and economic situation has become a valuable asset. As a result, Japan has established a new spy organization known as the "D Agency" to obtain this weapon. Under the command of Lieutenant Colonel Yuuki, eight agents have been assigned to infiltrate and observe some of the most powerful countries, reporting on any developments associated with the war. In order to carry out these dangerous tasks, these men have trained their bodies to survive in extreme conditions and studied numerous fields such as communications and languages. However, their greatest strength lies in their ability to manipulate people in order to obtain the information necessary to give their nation the upper hand. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Sennen Joyuu
items.synopsis: At the turn of the millennium, Ginei Studio's dilapidated buildings are set to be demolished. Ex-employee and filmmaker Genya Tachibana decides to honor this occasion with a commemorative documentary about the company's star actress: Chiyoko Fujiwara, the reclusive sweetheart of Shouwa Era cinema. Having finally obtained permission to interview the retired starlet, an enamored Genya drags along cynical cameraman Kyouji Ida to meet her, ready to put his lifelong idol back in the spotlight once more. Hidden in this secluded mountain retreat is a thousand years of history condensed into one lifetime, waiting to be narrated. Chiyoko's recollections take them on an illusionary journey through Japanese cinematic history that transcends the boundaries of reality; the saga of her acting career intertwines with her filmography, the actors in her life blend seamlessly with the characters on screen, and the present melds with the past. Though the actress may have retired at the height of her career 30 years ago, the curtain on her life's stage has yet to fall. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Con el cambio de milenio, los ruinosos edificios de Ginei Studio serán demolidos. La ex empleada y cineasta Genya Tachibana decide honrar esta ocasión con un documental conmemorativo sobre la actriz estrella de la compañía: Chiyoko Fujiwara, la novia solitaria del cine de la era Shouwa. Habiendo finalmente obtenido permiso para entrevistar a la estrella retirada, Genya, enamorada, arrastra al cínico camarógrafo Kyouji Ida para conocerla, listo para volver a poner a su ídolo de toda la vida en el centro de atención una vez más.

Escondidos en este aislado refugio de montaña hay mil años de historia condensados ​​en una sola vida, esperando ser narrados. Los recuerdos de Chiyoko los llevan en un viaje ilusorio a través de la historia del cine japonés que trasciende los límites de la realidad; la saga de su carrera como actriz se entrelaza con su filmografía, los actores de su vida se mezclan perfectamente con los personajes de la pantalla y el presente se funde con el pasado. Aunque es posible que la actriz se haya retirado en el apogeo de su carrera hace 30 años, el telón del escenario de su vida aún no ha caído.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Kono Sekai no Katasumi ni
items.synopsis: Suzu Urano is a pure and kindhearted girl who loves to draw and keep her head in the clouds. Growing up in the outskirts of Hiroshima with her family, she is more than happy to help with her grandmother's nori business. However, when she becomes of age, Suzu leaves her beloved home to marry Shuusaku Houjou, a man she barely knows. As she integrates into her new husband's household, the homesick bride struggles to adjust to the unfamiliar environment as the war effort extends far beyond its point of no return. When the war reaches Suzu's own backyard and peace gives way to brutality, how will she support herself and those she comes to love along the way? Kono Sekai no Katasumi ni paints a colorful yet haunting depiction of everyday life in the years before and after World War II, showcasing the perseverance and fortitude of ordinary Japanese during one of the darkest periods of modern history. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Suzu Urano es una chica pura y de buen corazón a la que le encanta dibujar y mantener la cabeza en las nubes. Al crecer en las afueras de Hiroshima con su familia, está más que feliz de ayudar con el negocio de nori de su abuela.

Sin embargo, cuando alcanza la mayoría de edad, Suzu deja su amado hogar para casarse con Shuusaku Houjou, un hombre al que apenas conoce. Mientras se integra en la casa de su nuevo marido, la novia nostálgica lucha por adaptarse al entorno desconocido mientras el esfuerzo de guerra se extiende mucho más allá de su punto de no retorno. Cuando la guerra llegue al patio trasero de Suzu y la paz dé paso a la brutalidad, ¿cómo podrá mantenerse a sí misma y a aquellos a quienes ama en el camino?

Kono Sekai no Katasumi ni pinta una descripción colorida pero inquietante de la vida cotidiana en los años anteriores y posteriores a la Segunda Guerra Mundial, mostrando la perseverancia y la fortaleza de los japoneses comunes y corrientes durante uno de los períodos más oscuros de la historia moderna.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Golden Kamuy 3rd Season
items.synopsis: After obtaining information about Asirpa from the foreteller Inkarmat, Saichi Sugimoto, Genjirou Tanigaki, and Cikapasi join the Seventh Division's Otonoshin Koito and Hajime Tsukishima on a journey to Karafuto. Heading further north into the freezing Russian territory, they collect any clues about Asirpa's whereabouts they can find and rush after her. Meanwhile, Asirpa is unaware of what truly transpired at Abashiri Prison. Deeply disturbed and confused by her father Wilk's past actions, Asirpa follows his old friend Kiroranke to the place where Wilk was born and raised in order to better understand his motives. However, Kiroranke and the master sniper Hyakunosuke Ogata are scheming behind her back. Even if they were to obtain all 24 tattooed skins that form a map to the lost Ainu gold, the various factions searching for it now understand that the map is useless without Asirpa. Realizing the danger she could be in, Sugimoto desperately hopes to reach Asirpa first and protect her from the greedy clutches of those who plan to drag her into their sins. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Después de obtener información sobre Asirpa del pronosticador Inkarmat, Saichi Sugimoto, Genjirou Tanigaki y Cikapasi se unen a Otonoshin Koito y Hajime Tsukishima de la Séptima División en un viaje a Karafuto. Dirigiéndose más al norte hacia el helado territorio ruso, recopilan cualquier pista que puedan encontrar sobre el paradero de Asirpa y corren tras ella.

Mientras tanto, Asirpa desconoce lo que realmente sucedió en la prisión de Abashiri. Profundamente perturbada y confundida por las acciones pasadas de su padre Wilk, Asirpa sigue a su viejo amigo Kiroranke al lugar donde nació y creció Wilk para comprender mejor sus motivos. Sin embargo, Kiroranke y el maestro francotirador Hyakunosuke Ogata están conspirando a sus espaldas.

Incluso si obtuvieran las 24 pieles tatuadas que forman un mapa del oro perdido de los Ainu, las distintas facciones que lo buscan ahora entienden que el mapa es inútil sin Asirpa. Al darse cuenta del peligro que podría correr, Sugimoto espera desesperadamente llegar primero a Asirpa y protegerla de las codiciosas garras de aquellos que planean arrastrarla a sus pecados.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Basilisk: Kouga Ninpou Chou
items.synopsis: For centuries, the Iga and Kouga ninja clans have engaged in a bitter war. But when a ceasefire is ordered by the powerful warlord Ieyasu Tokugawa, the two clans are forced to put down their arms. Years later, Gennosuke Kouga, heir of the Kouga clan, and Oboro Iga, heir of the Iga clan, have fallen in love. Through marriage, both heirs aim to bring peace to the clans. But their hopes are dashed when flames of rivalry between their clans are reignited, and they are dragged into another war. Ieyasu's two grandsons have both claimed to be the next heir to the shogunate. To resolve this dispute, both the Kouga and Iga are ordered to send their 10 best warriors to fight in a bloody battle royale, with each clan representing one of the potential shogunate heirs. Two scrolls with the names of the fighters are given and are to be marked in blood upon the given fighter's death. The prize for winning is the favor of the Tokugawa shogunate for a thousand years. Torn between their love for each other and duty to their clans, Gennosuke and Oboro must ultimately decide the fate of their clans. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Sukeroku Futatabi-hen
items.synopsis: Even after having risen to the utmost rank of shin'uchi, Yotarou struggles to find his own identity in the world of rakugo. Caught between his master's teachings and the late Sukeroku's unique style, his performance lacks an important ingredient—ego. And while his popularity packs the theaters, he is but one of the few; rakugo is under threat of being eclipsed. Meanwhile Yakumo, regarded by many as the last bastion of preserving the popularity of rakugo, struggles to cope with his elderly state. Even though his performances are still stellar, he fears that he is nearing his limits. His doubts grow stronger as an old friend creeps ever closer. Konatsu, for her part, attempts to raise her son as a single mother, which Yotarou is heavily opposed to. Instead, he seeks to persuade her to marry him and in turn raise her son as his own. In Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Sukeroku Futatabi-hen, the curtains fall on Yotarou and Yakumo's story, tasked with restoring the near-obsolete art form as well as overcoming their internal conflicts. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Incluso después de haber ascendido al máximo rango de shin'uchi, Yotarou lucha por encontrar su propia identidad en el mundo del rakugo. Atrapado entre las enseñanzas de su maestro y el estilo único del difunto Sukeroku, su actuación carece de un ingrediente importante: el ego. Y aunque su popularidad llena los cines, él es sólo uno de los pocos; rakugo está bajo amenaza de ser eclipsado.

Mientras tanto, Yakumo, considerado por muchos como el último bastión para preservar la popularidad del rakugo, lucha por hacer frente a su envejecimiento. Aunque sus actuaciones siguen siendo estelares, teme estar acercándose a sus límites. Sus dudas se hacen más fuertes a medida que un viejo amigo se acerca cada vez más. Konatsu, por su parte, intenta criar a su hijo como madre soltera, a lo que Yotarou se opone firmemente. En cambio, busca persuadirla para que se case con él y, a su vez, críe a su hijo como si fuera suyo.

En Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Sukeroku Futatabi-hen, cae el telón sobre la historia de Yotarou y Yakumo, quienes tienen la tarea de restaurar esta forma de arte casi obsoleta y superar sus conflictos internos.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Romeo x Juliet
items.synopsis: On the floating continent of Neo Verona, the Montague family slaughters the entire Capulet family and seizes control of the kingdom. The true heir to the throne, Juliet Fiammata Asto Capulet, manages to escape the onslaught and is hidden away by loyalists for 14 years with hope that she may one day overthrow the cruel Montague regime. Despite having forgotten the murder of her entire family, Juliet now secretly protects the oppressed citizens of Neo Verona as a vigilante called the Red Whirlwind. During one of her escapades she meets Romeo Candorebanto Montague, the kind and selfless son of the tyrannical Prince Laertes Montague, and without knowledge of each other's background, they both fall in love at first sight. Unfortunately, however, their destiny is a cursed one: not only does each of the two families wish to obliterate the other, but an ancient secret hidden beneath Neo Verona also threatens their undying love for each other. Will they be able to defy the stars, or is this truly a love that can never be? [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Shuumatsu no Izetta
items.synopsis: After Germania invaded a neighboring country in 1939, Europe spiraled into a devastating war. During the war, Germania set its sights on the weak alpine country of Elystadt. Boasting a far superior military and having achieved profuse success earlier in the war, it was expected that Germania would conquer Elystadt with ease. Matters are only made worse for the small country when Germanian soldiers capture their princess, Ortfiné "Finé" Fredericka von Eylstadt, as she is heading to a crucial meeting with Britannia. Yet, when a concurrent Germanian transport mission goes awry, Izetta, the last witch alive, escapes. When she recognizes Princess Finé from her childhood, Izetta rescues her from the Germanian soldiers by making use of her magical abilities. Now reunited with the princess, Izetta pledges to protect Elystadt from Germania, and with the last surviving witch on their arsenal, Elystadt hopes to turn the tides against the imperialist war giant. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Undead Girl Murder Farce
items.synopsis: In 19th-century France, the wife of vampire noble Jean Duchet Godard is murdered in her own home. With the local human authorities unwilling to properly investigate the case, Godard hires a pair of private detectives known to specialize in the supernatural: Tsugaru Shinuchi, a man with a mysterious birdcage; and his partner, Aya Rindou. This enigmatic duo has come from faraway Japan for one purpose—to track down the man who stole both Aya's body and Tsugaru's humanity. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama: The Final
items.synopsis: Two years have passed following the Tendoshuu's invasion of the O-Edo Central Terminal. Since then, the Yorozuya have gone their separate ways. Foreseeing Utsuro's return, Gintoki Sakata begins surveying Earth's ley lines for traces of the other man's Altana. After an encounter with the remnants of the Tendoshuu—who continue to press on in search of immortality—Gintoki returns to Edo. Later, the regrouped Shinsengumi and Yorozuya begin an attack on the occupied Central Terminal. With the Altana harvested by the wreckage of the Tendoshuu's ship in danger of detonating, the Yorozuya and their allies fight their enemies while the safety of Edo—and the rest of the world—hangs in the balance. Fulfilling the wishes of their teacher, Shouyou Yoshida's former students unite and relive their pasts one final time in an attempt to save their futures. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Han pasado dos años desde la invasión de los Tendoshuu a la Terminal Central de O-Edo. Desde entonces, los Yorozuya han tomado caminos separados. Previendo el regreso de Utsuro, Gintoki Sakata comienza a inspeccionar las líneas ley de la Tierra en busca de rastros del Altana del otro hombre. Después de un encuentro con los restos del Tendoshuu, que continúan buscando la inmortalidad, Gintoki regresa a Edo.

Más tarde, los Shinsengumi y Yorozuya reagrupados comienzan un ataque a la Terminal Central ocupada. Con el Altana cosechado por los restos del barco del Tendoshuu en peligro de detonar, los Yorozuya y sus aliados luchan contra sus enemigos mientras la seguridad de Edo (y el resto del mundo) está en juego. Cumpliendo los deseos de su maestro, los antiguos alumnos de Shouyou Yoshida se unen y reviven su pasado por última vez en un intento por salvar su futuro.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Baccano! Specials
items.synopsis: In 1929, Ladd Russo spared Graham Specter's life and earned his unwavering loyalty. Three years later, Graham is infuriated upon learning that Ladd was pushed off the train after the events aboard the Flying Pussyfoot. As a man of bizarre yet passionate philosophies, he plans to make an offering to Ladd by kidnapping Eve Genoard and subsequently capturing Jacuzzi Splot, who has been living in the Genoard mansion with his gang. Meanwhile, Jacuzzi and his gang take in an unfamiliar woman, Elmer C. Albatross pays a visit to the prison to meet an old friend, and Czeslaw Meyer runs into the man he hoped he would never see again. These seemingly separate storylines merge, tying up several loose ends and revealing the whole truth of the anomaly that occurred aboard the Advena Avis in 1711. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
En 1929, Ladd Russo perdonó la vida a Graham Specter y se ganó su lealtad inquebrantable. Tres años más tarde, Graham se enfurece al enterarse de que Ladd fue empujado fuera del tren después de los acontecimientos a bordo del Flying Pussyfoot. Como hombre de filosofías extrañas pero apasionadas, planea hacer una ofrenda a Ladd secuestrando a Eve Genoard y posteriormente capturando a Jacuzzi Splot, que ha estado viviendo en la mansión Genoard con su pandilla.

Mientras tanto, Jacuzzi y su pandilla acogen a una mujer desconocida, Elmer C. Albatross visita la prisión para encontrarse con un viejo amigo y Czeslaw Meyer se topa con el hombre que esperaba no volver a ver nunca más.

Estas historias aparentemente separadas se fusionan, atando varios cabos sueltos y revelando toda la verdad de la anomalía que ocurrió a bordo del Advena Avis en 1711.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Tsuki to Laika to Nosferatu
items.synopsis: On November 23, 1957, the whole world witnessed the Federal Republic of Zirnitra's monumental achievement of sending the first live animal—a dog—to outer space. Since then, the space race between the confederacy and its competitor, the United Kingdom of Arnack, has intensified; the two countries hope to one day send humans to the cosmos above. As a dog's biology is inherently different from a human's anatomy, there is no way to perfectly identify the risks involving space travel and its effects on an individual's body without actually sending someone for observation. However, Zirnitra's government has a potential solution: to experiment on vampires, whose biological similarity to humans is too significant to ignore. Despite being forcibly taken from her home in the mountains, vampire Irina Luminesk shows no resistance and is even willing to train as a test subject. Lev Leps, a former top candidate to become the first human cosmonaut, is designated to accompany Irina and act as her guide. Through their time together, Irina and Lev begin to develop a mutual love for outer space, bringing them closer together. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Tian Guan Cifu
items.synopsis: The heavens shake, the thunder rumbles, and Xie Lian appears with an apologetic smile—again! Eight hundred years prior, he was a beloved martial god, known as the Crown Prince of Xianle. Now, he ascends to the heavenly realm for the third time, but simply as a pitiful scrap-collecting god with no followers behind him. On his first mission, Xie Lian finds himself alone in the dark moonlit night. There, a gentle man dressed in red guides him through the forest. However, as abruptly as he appeared, the man suddenly dissipates into a swarm of silver butterflies. Xie Lian later learns that this mysterious stranger was none other than Hua Cheng, the Crimson Rain Sought Flower, a Ghost King feared by both demons and gods alike. But before Xie Lian can figure out why Hua Cheng would help a Heavenly Official like himself, he meets San Lang. A young man possessing great knowledge on not only the Ghost King, but also the now forgotten Crown Prince, San Lang decides to accompany Xie Lian on his journey of unveiling the mysteries of the past. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Los cielos tiemblan, los truenos retumban y Xie Lian aparece con una sonrisa de disculpa... ¡otra vez! Ochocientos años antes, era un amado dios marcial, conocido como el Príncipe Heredero de Xianle. Ahora, asciende al reino celestial por tercera vez, pero simplemente como un lamentable dios recolector de chatarra sin seguidores detrás de él. 

En su primera misión, Xie Lian se encuentra solo en la oscura noche iluminada por la luna. Allí, un caballero vestido de rojo lo guía por el bosque. Sin embargo, tan abruptamente como apareció, el hombre de repente se disipa en un enjambre de mariposas plateadas.

Más tarde, Xie Lian se entera de que este misterioso extraño no era otro que Hua Cheng, la Flor Buscada por la Lluvia Carmesí, un Rey Fantasma temido tanto por demonios como por dioses. Pero antes de que Xie Lian pueda descubrir por qué Hua Cheng ayudaría a un Oficial Celestial como él, conoce a San Lang. San Lang, un joven que posee un gran conocimiento no solo sobre el Rey Fantasma, sino también sobre el ahora olvidado Príncipe Heredero, decide acompañar a Xie Lian en su viaje para desvelar los misterios del pasado.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Gintama Movie 1: Shinyaku Benizakura-hen
items.synopsis: Gintoki and his Yorozuya friends (or rather, employees suffering under labor violations), Shinpachi and Kagura, continue to scrape by in the futuristic, alien-infested city of Edo. They take on whatever work they can find while trying not to get involved in anything too dangerous. But when Katsura, the leader of the Joui rebels and Gintoki's long-time acquaintance, disappears after being brutally attacked by an unknown assassin, Shinpachi and Kagura begin an investigation into his whereabouts and the identity of the assailant. Meanwhile, Gintoki takes on a seemingly unrelated job: the blacksmith Tetsuya requests that Gin recover a strange and powerful sword called the Benizakura which was recently stolen. As the two investigations gradually intersect, the Yorozuya crew find themselves in the midst of a major conspiracy that hinges on the sinister nature of the Benizakura sword. Gintoki resolves to take the fight directly to the enemy headquarters, and together with a few unexpected allies, sets out on one of his most perilous jobs yet. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
items.synopsis_es:
Gintoki y sus amigos Yorozuya (o más bien, los empleados que sufren violaciones laborales), Shinpachi y Kagura, continúan arreglándoselas en la ciudad futurista e infestada de extraterrestres de Edo. Asumen cualquier trabajo que puedan encontrar y al mismo tiempo intentan no involucrarse en nada demasiado peligroso. Pero cuando Katsura, el líder de los rebeldes Joui y conocido de Gintoki desde hace mucho tiempo, desaparece después de ser brutalmente atacado por un asesino desconocido, Shinpachi y Kagura comienzan una investigación sobre su paradero y la identidad del agresor. Mientras tanto, Gintoki asume un trabajo aparentemente no relacionado: el herrero Tetsuya le pide a Gin que recupere una extraña y poderosa espada llamada Benizakura que fue robada recientemente.

A medida que las dos investigaciones se cruzan gradualmente, el equipo de Yorozuya se encuentra en medio de una gran conspiración que gira en torno a la naturaleza siniestra de la espada Benizakura.
